Experienced DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer focused on scalable, secure cloud-native infrastructure and CI/CD automation.

Senior DevOps Engineer, Saffron Bank — Sep 2023 - Present
Designed and operated Kubernetes clusters supporting core banking microservices, improving deployment stability using k8s and Linux; implemented namespace and resource quotas to reduce noisy-neighbor incidents by 40%. Built Jenkins pipelines for automated build-test-deploy across environments, reducing average deployment time by 55% and rollback frequency by 30%. Automated server provisioning and configuration with Ansible on Linux hosts, integrating Git-based workflows for traceability.

Site Reliability Engineer, Finlytics — Oct 2018 - Aug 2023
Maintained CI/CD platform using Jenkins to orchestrate deployments for analytics services, increasing release cadence from weekly to daily while keeping rollback-safe practices. Architected Terraform and AWS Lambda integrations for event-driven processing, using SQS and CloudWatch for reliable backlog handling and alerting; optimized Lambda cold-starts and reduced processing latency by 25%. Implemented infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, versioned in Git, and automated Linux host configuration with Ansible to ensure consistent environments.

Skills: k8s, Terraform, Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux, Ansible, Git

Education: B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
